rounds.text: MMP Industries is currently trading at a significant premium to its sector benchmarks, with a P/E of 19.75x compared to the sector’s 17.82x and a P/B of 2.86x against the sector’s 2.21x [E6, E7]. This valuation expansion is occurring despite the company’s institutional exodus, as foreign and domestic institutional holdings have plummeted from a combined 6.52% to a negligible 0.02% since September 2023 [E42, E43]. The stock is currently priced at its 52-week high, leaving it vulnerable to its historical volatility, which includes a severe peak-to-trough drawdown of 73% and an annualized volatility of 50.2% [E48, E53, E54]. Furthermore, the company’s reliance on debt is increasing, with borrowings rising from Rs 156 Cr to Rs 185 Cr over the last year [E39]. While the company has shown growth, the current price-led momentum is outpacing fundamental performance, as evidenced by price growth exceeding profit growth by 29% in recent periods [E57]. Conceded: the company maintains strong sales growth [E14, E15, E17], positive cash conversion [E33], and a favorable sector tailwind [E68, E70].
